qualification: Civil Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Engineering, Computer Engineering:A three-year full-time Diploma in the relevant engineering discipline from a State Council/Board of Technical Education or recognized University/Institution. || HR Management, Office Administration, Finance & Accounts, Stores & Purchase:Bachelor's degree in any discipline (B.A/B.B.A/B.Com/B.Sc or equivalent). || R&D in Oceanography:Bachelor's degree in any science discipline such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Environment Science, Marine Science, Geology, Computer Science, or IT. || Library Sciences:Bachelor's Degree in Library and Information Science or equivalent from a UGC-recognized university. || Dispensary/Nursing:B.Sc. in Nursing or equivalent. || Guest House & Canteen Management:Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management or equivalent. || Desktop Publishing:Bachelor's degree in Visual Arts, Photography, Videography, Visual Communication, or equivalent.
salary: Candidates asking how much CSIR-NIO apprentices are paid can note that the stipend is fixed by category and does not vary by individual trade within that category. Technician (Diploma) apprentices receive Rs. 10,900/- per month , while Graduate (Non-Engineering Degree) apprentices receive Rs. 12,300/- per month , both for a training period of 1 year . || On successful completion of training, apprentices will be awarded a National Apprenticeship Certificate by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT)/BOAT . CSIR-NIO has no obligation to offer regular employment after training, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the basis of completing the apprenticeship.
age_limit: Candidates asking about the age criteria for this apprenticeship can note that the limit differs for Technician and Graduate apprentices, calculated as on the date of interview. Technician/Diploma apprentices must be between 18 and 24 years , while Graduate/Degree apprentices must be between 21 and 26 years , both as on 6 July 2026. || Age relaxation is applicable only on production of a relevant certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, signed by the competent authority.
selection_process: Candidates curious about how CSIR-NIO will select apprentices can note that the primary mode is a direct walk-in interview, with a written test only triggered under specific conditions. Document verification happens at the interview itself, and selection is provisional until certificates are fully verified. || Step 1 - Document Verification:Original and self-attested documents are checked at the walk-in interview venue. || Step 2 - Interview:Eligible candidates are interviewed by the Selection Committee starting at 10:15 AM. || Conditional Written Test:If the number of candidates is higher than what can be reasonably interviewed, theSelection Committee may conduct a written examinationand shortlist candidates for personal interview in proportion to available vacancies. || Final Selection:Engagement is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials; false or suppressed information at any stage can lead to cancellation or termination even after engagement.
